_comment: Bandit pyromancer ember aura (intermission triage Session ②, item 20): a medium-range fire aura that leaves a burning DoT — the pyromancer hangs back behind the melee bandits and cooks anything that lingers. Second 'fire' damage source in the world (the fire-teacher NPC's Ignite/Immolate are the first). Curve-position-1 baseline. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
